summary: Full E2E test of new conversion-tracking features. Backend: 38/38 pytest tests pass (leads CRUD + persistence, admin tracking settings group PUT/GET incl. public exposure, auth guards, services catalog regression). Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 390x844): all four lead forms (contact page, floating Inquiry modal, floating Call scheduler, homepage bottom form) submit successfully and redirect to /thank-you with personalized 'Thank you, {firstname}' heading, 3 step cards, WhatsApp + Call CTAs, and robots='noindex, nofollow'. All 8 tracking fields exist in Admin > Site settings; head_code saved via admin UI executed site-wide (window.__testHead===1, #rf-custom-head-code marker present) and thankyou_code executed only on /thank-you (window.__tyTest===1). SPA page_view verified firing on route change to /thank-you via injected gtag stub. UI-submitted leads verified persisted via GET /api/leads with admin JWT. All tracking fields were reset to empty strings afterwards (verified via GET /api/settings).

minor.issue: Accepts a lead with only 'name' (email and phone both empty/absent) -> 200. Intentional for the call-booking flow, but a lead with no contact channel is unactionable; consider requiring email OR phone server-side.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal title/subtitle are white text (rgb(255,255,255)) rendered above the modal card, over the blurred light page background — 'Send an inquiry' / 'Book a call' are near-illegible on light pages (verified computed color white, overlay fully animated in). Contrast failure.

Floating 'Inquiry' pill overlaps content text: on /thank-you it covers Step 2 card text ('Reply within ~30 min' / 'During business hours you'll hear back fast'), and on /contact it covers the footer CTA heading. Submit buttons themselves are NOT blocked (elementFromPoint at contact-submit center = contact-submit).

issues: Section header still reads 'Site settings (SEO, contact, social, business)' — does not mention the new Conversion tracking group, so admin may not know it's there.
Large empty vertical gap between hero copy and footer at 1920x1080 because content is centered in a max-w-3xl column with min-h-[80vh]; visually sparse but not broken.

action_items: Fix modal header text contrast in FloatingActions (white text over light blurred background) — e.g. move title inside the white card or add a dark scrim behind it.
On mobile, add bottom padding / hide-on-scroll behaviour so the floating Inquiry pill does not sit on top of /thank-you step-card text and footer CTA text.
Optional: rename the Site settings section header to include 'conversion tracking'.

Optional hardening: /thank-you fires trackConversion + thankyou_code on every mount, including direct visits and page reloads with no navigation state — this can inflate Google Ads/Meta conversion counts. Consider a one-shot guard (sessionStorage key per lead id) and passing the lead id through navigate state.
Optional cleanup: CallScheduler sets done=true and immediately navigates to /thank-you, so the 'call-success' success block (data-testid=call-success) is dead code.
critical_code_review_comments: ThankYou.jsx fires trackConversion()/fireThankyouCode() unconditionally on mount — reloading /thank-you or bookmarking it double-counts conversions. Guard with a per-submission token.
siteConfig.injectHtml wraps injected HTML in a display:none div; fine for

initTracking() runs once behind window.__trackingLoaded; if admin changes tracking IDs, existing sessions never pick them up until a hard reload (acceptable, but note the admin hint already says 'Save + refresh').

/app/backend/tests/test_case_studies.py (fixed stale hardcoded BASE_URL/admin creds — was 404/401 failing)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of functional flows passed; 2 medium UI/design issues found

seed_data_creation: Test leads created (safe to leave / delete): TEST Playwright Contact, TEST Inquiry Modal, TEST Home Form, TEST Call Booking, TEST TY Code, TEST Mobile User, TEST SPA PageView, plus TEST_Lead <uuid> from pytest. One pytest lead status was toggled contacted->new (reset).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives in /app/backend/tests (38 tests, all green; run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q). test_tracking_leads.py covers the tracking settings group and resets head_code/body_code/thankyou_code/gtm_id to '' in a session teardown. All tracking fields are currently empty (verified via GET /api/settings). Frontend flows already verified: contact/inquiry-modal/call-scheduler/homepage forms -> /thank-you, head_code + thankyou_code execution, SPA page_view, noindex meta, mobile 390x844 no horizontal overflow on /, /contact, /thank-you and the inquiry modal. Remaining open items are purely visual (modal header contrast, floating button overlap on mobile).
rca_of_the_issue: Modal header contrast: FloatingActions.Modal renders title/subtitle with text-white outside the white card, relying on the bg-ink/60 backdrop for contrast; because the header sits above the card over a blurred light hero, the effective background is light and white text loses contrast. Floating-button overlap: the fixed bottom-right stack has z-50 and pages have no extra bottom padding on mobile, so the pill lands on top of content in the lower-right region.
